content.stem: 以下哪些是欧盟受监管资产管理公司的合规经理应实施的重要反洗钱控制措施？(选择两项.)

options.A: 邀请潜在客户参加入职面谈
options.B: 拒绝任何政治公众人物(PEP)成为客户
options.C: 了解资产的来源和出处
options.D: 对潜在客户进行负面新闻核查
options.E: 编制有关重点客户的金融稳定报告

content.stem_en: Which of the following are important AML controls for a compliance manager of a regulated asset management company in the European Union to implement? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Inviting prospective customers for an onboarding interview
options_en.B: Rejecting any politically exposed persons (PEPs) as customers
options_en.C: Understanding the source and origin of assets
options_en.D: Performing negative news checks of prospective customers
options_en.E: Producing financial stability reports on key customers
